page.overview:
What is Pokémon Center Nurse?

Pokémon Center Ladies are a group of characters introduced in Generation I. They work at a Pokémon Center, where they use a machine to restore the Pokémon in a Pokémon Trainer's party to full health, restoring every Pokémon's HP and PP entirely, curing them of any status condition, and reviving any Pokémon that has fainted.

In , Pokémon Center Ladies are identified as Nurse Joys instead. Nurse Joys are identified mainly from having pink hair sorted into two hoops. Pokémon Center Ladies have appeared in the anime on rare occasions. In certain appearances, Pokémon Center Ladies are usually associated with Chanseys because of their Nurse Joy counterparts.

In all games of the core series, a Pokémon Center Lady is placed behind the counter of Pokémon Center in nearly every town and city. If the player talks to the Pokémon Center Lady, she offers to restore their Pokémon to full health, free of charge. If the player says yes, she takes every Poké Ball containing a Pokémon in the player's party and puts them on a healing machine, which operates for a few seconds, before returning them to the player.

In , the Pokémon Center Ladies have a different appearance than in to more closely resemble their anime counterparts, Nurse Joys, namely from the nurse's hat, and they are also seen with the exact one in the Generation II games and .
